In response, developers are paying tribute to the legendary RPG studio online, with many calling its games pivotal to their own creative paths.

17-year BioWare veteran and longtime director Michael Gamble shared the studio's news post. "Your support has meant everything to me over the past 17 years at BioWare," he writes.

New Bungie head Josh Deane replied to Gamble's post, saying, "Thank you and to everyone at Bioware who has built worlds that have been such an important part of our lives." In a separate post , Deane adds, "This studio is magical and an existential part of my favorite gaming memories, I refuse to believe this..."

CD Projekt Red veteran Paweł Sasko, a face of the studio to many fans of Cyberpunk 2077 and The Witcher, says "Baldur's Gate 1 and 2 shaped my imagination and the desire to create games. I would have never been here without BioWare igniting the fire in my heart. It inspired me, formed me, enriched my imagination, and for that I will be forever grateful. I will always remember you."

CDPR co-CEO Michał Nowakowski adds , "Bioware has been a massive part of CDPR history. We befriended them when localizing and selling Baldur's Gate games in Poland, Czech, and Slovakia. And later they were [a] great help when lending us their engine for Witcher 1, sharing their wisdom and even giving us a spot at their booth at E3.

Standing on BioWare's grave, EA says "we should be proud" to be top "publisher in Western HD gaming" EA cancels new Mass Effect, closes BioWare after being bought by Saudi Arabia Skyrim and Fallout made Bethesda devs feel "safe" from mass layoffs "I had [the] pleasure to visit them a few times in Edmonton and also host them in our Warsaw office. Very sad for the people affected, but also sad to see a legendary brand go down. Not a great day in the games industry."

Gamble responded to Nowakowski's post, saying, "Thanks Michal. We've always been fans of you guys. Always will be."

InXile Entertainment head Brian Fargo also commented on the original Baldur's Gate games. "We saw the promise in what they could do," he says of BioWare's days on Shattered Steel, "and they went on to create Baldur's Gate 1 and 2 and become legendary. A sad day indeed. My thoughts are with everyone there today."

Mortal Kombat's Ed Boon is of a similar mind. "Very sorry to hear. They made some amazing games," he says of BioWare's shutdown statement.

Comms director Thomas Puha of Control and Alan Waker studio Remedy sums up the thoughts of many: "RIP BioWare. This was coming but so sad to read. The growing problem for large publishers is that smaller AAA games won’t bring enough money so can’t take the risk on them, but not doing original games? We need those, need new franchises."

Standing on BioWare's grave, EA says "we should be proud" to be top "publisher in Western HD gaming" EA cancels new Mass Effect, closes BioWare after being bought by Saudi Arabia Skyrim and Fallout made Bethesda devs feel "safe" from mass layoffs "Really sad outcome for a studio that helped define an entire genre," reckons Del Walker, an artist known for his work on The Last of Us Part 2 Remastered and Star Wars Jedi: Survivor. Walker suggests the studio's closure is "the result of about 15 years of problems piling up," including consecutive commercial failures, mismanagement, and increased scrutiny from an EA team staring down billions in debt post-buyout.

Veteran games writer Emma Kidwell calls the shutdown "a massive fucking failure on EA's part."

items.title: 'Cyberpunk 2077' is getting a huge new co-op mod
items.summary: Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a new co-op mod this week that lets up to eight players team up.
items.content:
By Elijah Gonzalez Published Oct 21, 2026, 12:38 PM EDT Elijah is a freelance news writer at Polygon. He was an associate editor at The A.V. Club and Paste, and has been featured in outlets like Game Informer, Fanbyte, Unwinnable, and more. He loves media in all forms, from fighting games and horror flicks to slow cinema and visual novels. He's from the Greater Boston area. News Up to eight players can sow chaos in NightCoop

Image: CD Projekt Red Add Polygon.com on Google Add as Preferred Source Follow on Google Discover Cyberpunk 2077 Sign in to your Polygon.com account Summary Generate a summary of this story Like Like follow Follow followed Followed Thread Log in Here is a fact-based summary of the story contents: Try something different: Show me the facts Explain it like I’m 5 Give me a lighthearted recap Night City is having a busy week. Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a major 2.5 update on Oct. 22, coinciding with the recent release of the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 anime. CD Projekt Red just confirmed what’s in 2.5, including new quests, a perk that enables dual wielding, console mod support, and more. However, the game is arguably getting an even bigger update through unofficial channels: Cyberpunk 2077 is receiving multiplayer co-op support via the NightCoop mod.

NightCoop is a fan-made mod that lets up to eight players take on Night City together. A recently released trailer dives into the details, immediately tackling edge cases that almost certainly gave the mod’s programmers a headache. NightCoop will synchronize the world of Cyberpunk 2077 so combat and stealth work seamlessly for all players. This even applies when a partner activates their Sandevistan to slow time, causing others to see them moving with an afterimage like in the anime.

As for choices and dialogue, these are put to a vote, with the majority choice playing out for all players. The trailer culminates in a duo carrying out a heist, with one operating cameras and drones and the other leading a frontal assault. After closed tests, the mod enters open beta on Oct. 23 at 11 a.m. EDT.

According to NightCoop’s website , the mod will also support PvP, which can be toggled by the host. Player-versus-player shootouts will take into account both combatants’ stats and gear, but will even out damage between those of different levels. To set up the mod, players install NightCoop and the library RED4ext . Then the host loads an existing save or creates a new co-op game, and guests join the host’s game as their own V.

CD Projekt Red has long supported fan-modding efforts , taking the unusual step of adding mod support to the console releases of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt and now Cyberpunk 2077 . The game’s RED4ext modding library has a whopping 12.6 million downloads on Nexus Mods, showing just how popular player-made additions have been .

items.content: Matthew Wilson 14 hours ago Featured Tech News , Software & Gaming

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 Has Just Been Added To Xbox Play Anywhere
items.content:
I've talked a fair bit on Pure Xbox about my love for Xbox Play Anywhere and how it's my favourite feature. Well, I'm feeling quite happy about it again, because the fantastic Cyberpunk 2077 appears to finally support Xbox Play Anywhere, meaning you get a free Xbox PC version included alongside the console one!

Rollout seems to be happening as we speak, because while the Xbox Play Anywhere tag appears on Cyberpunk 2077's Xbox Store page and as an 'Installable' game on the Xbox PC app, it still seems to prompt Cloud Gaming.

Cyberpunk 2077 is getting a big update later this week , featuring console mods and various other bits and bobs. This is a game that has always felt like it should already support Xbox Play Anywhere, and I was consistently disappointed whenever I forgot it didn't and tried to install it on my ROG Ally.

If you've already played Cyberpunk 2077 to death, there's plenty more Xbox Play Anywhere titles still to come this year, including Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade , which was just announced as coming to Xbox Game Pass this October , as well as rumours that Star Wars: Galactic Racer could get XPA support too .

items.content:
Thought you were done with Night City? Well, Night City's not quite done with you!

Patch notes for Cyberpunk 2077's Edgerunners 2 Update (2.5) are now available for your early perusal before the update hits the streets on October 22nd. Watch the Features Overview video to see some of the new features in action:

And if you want to know even more, read through the list of most important changes below:

Edgerunners Content

  • Added a new side quest, Clampdown, set before the events of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. To unlock it, complete The Heist and two gigs for Wakako, then wait for a message from her.

    [/*]

  • Added a new 5-piece gear set based on the character King, which can be obtained during the Clampdown side quest.

    [/*]

  • Added a new radio station, HKGN 102.0 FM, featuring a selection of tracks from the Cyberpunk: Edgerunners series.

    [/*]

Show Off

  • A brand-new clothing collection has arrived in Night City! 5 new outfit sets can now be purchased from certain clothing vendors:

    • Maxiwear: available in Heywood, Arroyo, Little China

      [/*]

    • Jinguji: available in City Center

      [/*]

    • NetWatch: available in Kabuki, Japantown

      [/*]

    • IconAmerica: available in Pacifica, Badlands, Northside

      [/*]

    • And one more set that will hit Night City shelves just a little later...

      [/*]
    [/*]

  • The NUS Infiltrator clothing set can be now purchased from clothing vendors in Kabuki and Japantown.

    [/*]

  • 4 new TWINTONE skins for Quadra Turbo-R V-Tech are now available via Twitch Drops.

    [/*]

  • Some of the hairstyles that were previously exclusive to NPCs are now available for V. Please note that some hairstyles are available only to feminine or masculine body types.

    [/*]

  • Show off your chrome! You can now customize your hand cyberware. Equip your Mantis Blades, Gorilla Arms, Monowire or Projectile Launch System, and visit one of 5 Glamdocs (marked with a spray paint icon on the map) to give your implants a fresh, new look. Each Glamdoc is located in a unique shop, along with their own intro scene with voiceover and animations, and offers a unique catalog of cyberware skins with customizable colors.

    [/*]

  • Sometimes one gun just isn't enough. The new Double Trouble perk in the Cool tree (along with four auxiliary perks) introduces an entirely new playstyle, allowing you to dual-wield Pistols and Revolvers from the Power category.

    [/*]

  • Added frames from the Cyberpunk Trading Card Game to Photo Mode, allowing you to make your preem shots look like custom cards.

    [/*]

  • Added new poses in Photo Mode to show off your dual-wielding prowess.

    [/*]

Mod the World

Added Cross-Platform Mod Support, powered by mod.io, a first step into cross-platform modding that allows you to easily browse and install a selection of player-created mods directly from the in-game menu. More mods will become available over time. The feature is available on PC, Mac, PlayStation 5, PlayStation 5 Pro and Xbox Series X|S.

Upgrading the World

  • Welcome to Paradise! Added a new side quest that takes you on a journey to uncover a mystery and explore Night City on a guided tour narrated by Richard Night. It unlocks after completing The Heist and reaching level 15 Street Cred.

    [/*]

  • Added 12 new Minor Arcana Tarot Cards to discover across Night City. The Tarot menu now has separate sections for Major and Minor Arcana. The new tarot cards are part of a new side quest, an extension of Fool on the Hill, which activates after scanning any of the new cards. Collect them all to get a special reward.

    [/*]

Quality of Life

  • Saves in the “Load Game” menu are now grouped by separate playthroughs.

    [/*]

  • Added item filters to apartment and vehicle stashes.

    [/*]

  • Modded saves in the "Load Game" menu are now marked with a dedicated icon. Please note that achievements and trophies cannot be earned while playing on console from a modded save file.

    [/*]

  • Updated the selection of AMD FSR options. FSR 3 upscaling is no longer included, while FSR 2.1, FSR 4, and FSR 3.1 Frame Generation remain available.

    [/*]

  • Updated the CD PROJEKT RED Account connection, My Rewards and telemetry consent menus.

    [/*]

Technology

  • Added support for DLSS 4.5, including up to 6X Multi Frame Generation or Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and the 2nd Generation Transformer Model.

    [/*]

  • Added support for glasses-free 3D effects on compatible Samsung Odyssey 3D monitors, along with a Motion Comfort setting that lets you balance 3D depth and viewing comfort.

    [/*]

  • Added support for MetalFX Frame Interpolation on Mac.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle in settings for FSR Anti-Lag 2.

    [/*]

  • Introduced various performance optimizations, including improvements specifically for Ray Tracing.

    [/*]

  • Improved HDR rendering to provide more accurate colors, brightness, and contrast on compatible displays.

    [/*]

Fixes

  • Things Done Changed- Fixed an issue where the Delamain cab could get stuck after crashing into another vehicle, blocking quest progression.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where enabling Film Grain had no effect.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where tagging enemies while scanning could also cause V to crouch or stand up when using certain control schemes.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where controller settings for the Third-Person Camera were missing.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several typos in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added various other fixes for features and content introduced since Patch 2.1.

    [/*]

items.title: NVIDIA Brings Advanced Shader Delivery To Call of Duty: MW4 & Gears of War: E-Day In Latest Drivers While Cyberpunk 2077 Updated To Support 2nd Gen DLSS AI Models
items.summary: NVIDIA released latest Game Ready drivers that add Microsoft Advanced Shader Delivery support while Cyberpunk 2077 gets a major DLSS upgrade.
items.content:
NVIDIA released its latest Game Ready drivers that add Microsoft Advanced Shader Delivery support while Cyberpunk 2077 gets a major DLSS upgrade.

First up, we have Cyberpunk 2077 , which is getting a new 2.5 update on 22nd October . With this update, the game will receive support for DLSS 4.5 Dynamic Multi Frame Generation, and is also going to upgrade its already-supported Multi Frame Generation, Ray Reconstruction, and Super Resolution integrations to second-generation AI models.

Game Ready for Phantom Blade Zero & Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 (GRD 621.01) This new Game Ready Driver provides the best gaming experience for the latest games and updates supporting DLSS and RTX technologies, including Phantom Blade Zero, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4, NBA 2K27, Cyberpunk 2077, and Crimson Desert Enhanced: Charting the Unknown.

The second major update comes in the form of two new titles that will get Microsoft's Advanced Shader Delivery support . These include Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 and Gears of War: E-Day .

items.title: Cyberpunk 2077 is finally getting the co-op mode gamers have wanted for 6 years
items.summary: Night City is about to get a lot more chaotic with friends 😂🎮
items.content:
Take over Night City with friends by your side!

Cyberpunk 2077 is getting what looks to be a seamless co-op mode, letting friends explore Night City together six years after fans first hoped to experience the story campaign in multiplayer.

Depending on your perspective, some gamers would love to see multiplayer co-op in open-world games. The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim and Fallout 4 could be even better with a friend, while Red Dead Redemption 2 and The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt might be better off without it.

One other game that could benefit from having co-op multiplayer is the aforementioned Cyberpunk 2077 from CD Projekt RED , and as stated at the top of this article, a talented modder is making it happen.

While NightCoop is currently a work in progress, the developers intend to begin public testing on the unofficial mode on October 23, 2026. In its current closed testing phase, the mod covers the prologue and Act 1 of the Cyberpunk 2077 campaign.

When development is complete, NightCoop aims to let up to eight players explore Night City together online. Each player will control their own version of V, with multiple-choice dialogue decisions determined by a vote among players. What's more, the cinematic cutscenes will remain intact.

It's worth noting that NightCoop isn't the only Cyberpunk 2077 multiplayer project in development. While NightCoop aims to bring co-op to the story campaign, OPEN//77 focuses on multiplayer servers and custom activities, offering a different way to experience Night City with other players.

READ MORE: Cyberpunk 2077 players can now possess enemies in free mod, opening up a whole new play style

Sadly, as is the case with all Cyberpunk 2077 mods, NightCoop is a PC exclusive and is not available on consoles. Cyberpunk 2077 and its Phantom Liberty expansion are also available on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2.

items.title: New Cyberpunk 2077 Sale Brings the Ultimate Edition to Its Lowest Price Ever
items.summary: Pick up Cyberpunk 2077 and its Phantom Liberty expansion for cheaper than ever before in a sale on one platform.
items.content:
Share on X (Opens in new window) X Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook Add Us On Google A new sale for Cyberpunk 2077 has brought the Ultimate Edition of the game to its lowest price ever. With the arrival of the Phantom Liberty expansion for Cyberpunk 2077 back in 2023, CD Projekt Red released an Ultimate Edition of its first-person RPG that included all of the game’s content in a single package. Since then, this has been the definitive version of Cyberpunk 2077 to buy for those who haven’t yet picked up the title. And while countless millions have since bought Cyberpunk 2077 for themselves, a new offer may be too good to pass up for those who have remained on the fence.

As of this week, Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition has seen its value cut all the way down to $27.99. This represents a discount of over $40, as the game normally retails for $69.99. The deal, which is set to last until November 3rd, represents the lowest amount that the Ultimate Edition of Cyberpunk 2077 has ever sold for, making this the most notable discount in the game’s history.

The downside with this deal is that it doesn’t apply to all versions of Cyberpunk 2077 . Instead, the sale is only live on the Nintendo eShop for the Switch 2 edition of the game. As a result, those on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC platforms can’t get Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition for the same low price.

While this might be a disappointment, it’s still impressive that Cyberpunk 2077 is this cheap on Switch 2 to begin with. The Switch 2 version of the game is technically the newest one that has been released, as it just launched in tandem with the new Nintendo hardware last year. As such, for its price to have been cut by this much is quite impressive given that the Ultimate Edition has never been as low on the PlayStation Store, Xbox Store, or Steam.

Fortunately, for those looking to pick up Cyberpunk 2077: Ultimate Edition on other platforms, similar offers are currently ongoing. The Ultimate Edition on Steam is now down to $33.10, while the Xbox Store is only a bit more costly at $31.99. A similar sale has yet to kick in on the PS Store, but it likely will in the days to come.

As for the reason behind these sales, it almost certainly has to do with the arrival of Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 this week . The new release in the hugely popular anime series is driving greater interest in Cyberpunk as a whole, which has prompted CDPR to discount the game to take advantage. So if you end up watching Edgerunners 2 for yourself and want to snag the Ultimate Edition , now would definitely be the best time to do so.

items.title: FSR 4.1.1 vs DLSS 4.5 Performance Comparison Radeon RX 7800 XT in Game Cyberpunk 2077
items.summary: A user conducted a detailed benchmarking of various image scaling technologies on a video card. AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT with...
items.content:
Login without a password Sign In Forgot your password? Forgot your username? News GAMES FSR 4.1.1 vs DLSS 4.5 Performance Comparison Radeon RX 7800 XT in Game Cyberpunk 2077 Maxim Boldson GAMES October 19 2026 Views: 9197 A user conducted a detailed benchmarking of various image scaling technologies on a video card. AMD Radeon RX 7800 XT benchmarked using the NeuralHub toolkit from the DLSS-NR-on-AMD fan project. During initial measurements, the enthusiast made a technical error in the settings, as the utility did not automatically override the FSR 4.1.1 algorithm when selecting DLSS in the game interface. A re-benchmark with all configuration fixes was performed in Cyberpunk 2077 version 2.3 in resolution 2560x1440 with a balanced upscaling mode, high texture quality, and active reflections, shadows, and mid-level lighting using ray tracing without path tracing. The test rig included an AMD Ryzen 7 7700X processor, 32 GB of RAM, and a graphics driver. Radeon Software version 26.8.1 in the operating system environment Windows 11.

The results of the built-in benchmark demonstrated a significant difference in performance when switching to NVIDIA algorithms based on the transformer model. When using the graphics card's native AMD FSR 4.1.1 technology in Balanced mode, the graphics accelerator Radeon RX 7800 XT delivered an average frame rate of 64,30 FPS, with a minimum of 55,70 FPS and a maximum of 76,48 FPS. Switching to the unofficially launched DLSS 4.5 technology with the M preset without ray reconstruction resulted in a drop in average performance to 37,47 FPS, with a minimum of 34,29 FPS and a maximum of 41,45 FPS. Additional activation of the function DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction With preset F, the average frame rate dropped to 27,79 FPS, with a range from 26,16 FPS to 29,42 FPS.

The performance drop when running DLSS 4.5 on the AMD RDNA 3 architecture is completely consistent with previous benchmarks by user countervolts on the video card. Radeon RX 7700 XT in Silent Hill TownfallIn that project, when selecting the mode Quality At 1705x960, FSR 4 delivered 76,0 FPS, DLSS 3 CNN with the E preset delivered 71,7 FPS, DLSS 4 with the K preset delivered 67,9 FPS, and DLSS 4.5's Hard mode with the M preset dropped the frame rate to 49,3 FPS. In Balanced mode at 1488x837, the results were 84,5 FPS for FSR 4 versus 58,0 FPS for DLSS 4.5, and in Performance mode at 1280x720, the frame rate reached 94,0 FPS and 69,0 FPS, respectively. The benchmark author expressed hope for the soon implementation of ray reconstruction from DLSS 4.0, which will become a more practical solution for mid-range graphics cards.

items.title: Patch 2.31
items.summary: Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live! This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below: Vehicles Updated Aut
items.content:
Patch 2.31 for Cyberpunk 2077 is now live!

This update includes an AutoDrive upgrade and Photo Mode adjustments. It also addresses common issues encountered by players. For details, check the full list of changes below:

Vehicles

  • Updated AutoDrive. When driving to a selected point, the vehicle now drives smoothly, overtakes blocking vehicles and no longer stops at traffic lights. Free Roam mode has also been upgraded to follow traffic rules and navigate the city more reliably.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Johnny always spawned in the passenger seat when using the Delamain Cab service.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where applying CrystalCoat to the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru caused its wheels to flash in different colors.

    [/*]

Photo Mode

  • Most of the new poses introduced in Update 2.3 now work with any gender.

    [/*]

  • Disabled NPC collision, which will make it easier to position NPCs on top of other objects with collision (e.g. on car hoods).

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where some of the poses didn't work for Royce.

    [/*]

Quests & Open World

  • Freedom - Fixed the journal entry that appears when the player chooses not to steal the Rayfield Caliburn "Mordred."

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where, after V fails to pursue and stop Semimaru and receives a text from River saying he'll contact V soon, the follow-up message never arrives.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Fixed an issue where the Yaiba Semimaru could flip over during the chase, preventing the player from entering it.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - It's no longer possible to trigger the quest if River died during The Hunt.

    [/*]

  • Motorbreath - Players can now acquire the Yaiba ARV-Q340 Semimaru through AUTOFIXER even if they failed The Hunt, which normally unlocks the side quest where the vehicle is obtained.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed a game crash that could occur in certain circumstances after leaving the Yaiba showroom event.

    [/*]

  • Nitro (Youth Energy) - Fixed an issue where the proxy interface UI in the Yaiba showroom is cut off when the "Larger HUD Elements" setting is enabled.

    [/*]

Miscellaneous

  • Fixed several localization and lipsync issues in various languages.

    [/*]

  • Added a toggle to disable vignette. It can be found in Settings → Graphics → Basic.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on PC and Mac where Ray-Traced Reflections might not display correctly when enabled under certain conditions.

    [/*]

  • Fixed several issues with displaying text messages from Delamain.

    [/*]

  • Various fixes for fluff vendors.

    [/*]

PC-specific

  • Fixed an issue where NVIDIA Reflex could be disabled while DLSS Frame Generation was enabled, causing the screen to turn pink.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where Path Tracing didn't activate properly in certain scenarios.

    [/*]

Mac-specific

  • Fixed an issue where changing graphics presets on Mac set Screen Space Reflections to a higher setting compared to the equivalent presets on PC.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue causing a permanent white screen when Frame Generation is enabled while entering the braindance in The Information.

    [/*]

  • Selecting "Defaults" in Video Settings no longer turns HDR Mode off.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue where setting the MetalFX DRS Maximum Resolution above the value applied by the “For this Mac” preset could cause visual artifacts.

    [/*]

  • Fixed the inverted behavior of the "Mute Game in Background" toggle in Settings.

    [/*]

  • Removed the outdated "(Requires Game Restart)" disclaimer from the mouseover description of the "Disable Spatial Audio" setting.

    [/*]

  • Fixed an issue on the App Store version that caused the game to become stuck on the “Press Space to continue” breaching screen.

    [/*]

  • Various stability and performance optimizations.

    [/*]
